 "path": "programs/task-7630340f.py",
 "content": "def transform(grid):
    h, n = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Find uniform separator, then compare corresponding cells in the two panels.
    vc = next((c for c in range(n) if all(row[c] == grid[0][c] for row in grid)), None)
    if vc is not None:
        w = min(vc, n-vc-1)
        left = [row[:w] for row in grid]
        right = [row[vc+1:vc+1+w] for row in grid]
        pairs = [left[r][c] for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if left[r][c] == right[r][c]]
        bg = max(set(pairs), key=pairs.count) if pairs else 0
        return [[3 if left[r][c] == right[r][c] else bg for c in range(w)] for r in range(h)]
    hr = next(r for r,row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1)
    top, bot = grid[:hr], grid[hr+1:]
    rows = min(len(top),len(bot)); cols=len(grid[0])
    pairs = [top[r][c] for r in range(rows) for c in range(cols) if top[r][c] == bot[r][c]]
    bg = max(set(pairs), key=pairs.count) if pairs else 0
    return [[3 if top[r][c] == bot[r][c] else bg for c in range(cols)] for r in range(rows)]
"
}
